notes.title: IF YOU LIKE THE GAME PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34036220/a493661ec4311842d46368ac75569df394cda462.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody.

First of all, thank you very much to all of you who have acquired Deca and have played it, we hope you have enjoyed the experience as much as we did in its development.

If you liked the game we wanted to ask you a huge favor. You would help us enormously if you leave your review so that people can see your opinions and that way we can reach as many people as possible.

This will help us enormously to continue developing the next project, with much more quality, many more puzzles and much more terrifying.

A big hug to everyone!

notes.content: Finaly we solve the conection problem with Steam

notes.title: ¡¡¡¡DECA RELEASE!!!!
notes.content:
Hellow every body we are so happy to present you the final version of DECA!

To thank you for your support during development, we have given access one day before launch to people who purchased early access.

If you have any problem updating the game, uninstall the previous version and reinstall the new one.

We hope you enjoy the game a lot and that it scares you!
